title: Reported proportion is not achievable for the stated N
description: 84.7% over N=500 integer items is not round(k/500) at 1 decimal place(s) for any integer k (nearest achievable 84.8%). The value, its precision, or N may be misreported, or trials may have been excluded.

evidence.span: On a held-out test set of 500 examples, FooNet's accuracy is 84.7\%.

recommended_reviewer_action: Ask the authors to reconcile the value, its precision, and the exact denominator N (e.g. excluded/invalid items, or a macro/weighted average rather than a simple proportion).
